title: Trip
description: One motorcycle trip: the days, the base camps you sleep at, the campsites, and the pre-departure checklist. The whole plan is this one document. Give it to a model and ask for another trip in the same shape.

slug.description: Short lowercase identifier, unique across trips. Example: "provence".

name.description: Display name. Short — it sits in a tab.

subtitle.description: The region in plain words, shown above the name.

bounds.description: The map window the trip opens at. Stops well outside it are flagged as a likely swapped lat/lon.

lat1.description: Northern edge. Must be greater than lat0.

lon1.description: Eastern edge. Must be greater than lon0.

vanIn.description: Kilometres the van drives from home to the first base.

vanOut.description: Kilometres the van drives home from the last base.

bases.description: Camps you sleep at for several nights and ride out from.

index.description: 1, 2, 3 … in the order you reach them. Unique.

arriveDay.description: The day you pitch here. Must be a day that exists.

days.description: Every day of the trip. Day numbers must run 1..N with no gaps.

type.description: "ride" is a day out from a base; "van" is a day the transporter moves.

base.description: Where you sleep, as written on the roadbook.

detail.description: What the day is actually like, and anything that will bite you.

km.description: Planned riding kilometres. 0 on a pure transfer day.

van.description: Van transfer kilometres. 0 on a riding day.

stops.description: Places the day passes through, in riding order. Two or more to be routable; leave empty for a pure transfer with no stops. A loop day repeats its base at the start and end.

lat.description: Latitude. For France this is roughly 42–51.

lon.description: Longitude. For France this is roughly -5 to 8.

campsites.description: One entry per base. Use status "not-researched" for a base with nothing chosen yet rather than leaving it out — an open task is more useful than a gap.

base.description: The base index this campsite serves.

baseName.description: Filled in by the server from the base list.

coordsApprox.description: True when lat/lon are the base town rather than the pitch.

closingDateVerified.description: Whether someone has actually confirmed the site is open on your dates.

rejectedCampsites.description: Sites looked at and turned down, with the reason, so nobody researches the same ground twice.

campsiteCaveat.description: Standing warning shown above the campsite list.

kit.description: Pre-departure checklist, grouped. Put anything legally required in a group with legal: true.

legal.description: Items here carry a fine, not an inconvenience.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique across the whole checklist. Tick state is keyed by it — reusing an id from a previous version keeps its tick, renaming one loses it.

why.description: Why it matters. Concrete beats stern.

flag.description: A fine or an open question.
